cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a root vegetable farm — neat tilled rows, a wooden harvest crate, a wheelbarrow and a barn in the distance
cuts.scene: she is the farm owner standing with her hands folded at the edge of the tilled rows, pleased with the neat harvest crates
cuts.outfit: a farmer look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved denim shirt tied at the waist and short denim shorts with boots and a straw hat, bare legs, a triple-leaf stitched patch on her hat
